explication: Rswag turns RSpec request specs into executable API descriptions and OpenAPI documents, then serves those documents through a Rails API endpoint alongside an embedded Swagger UI. The principal workflow is spec DSL → request construction and validation → OpenAPI formatting → document serving and UI exploration. The tree and README establish those capabilities, but excerpts show only selected wiring; unverified internal calls are omitted rather than inferred.
